preregistration_label: Author-declared pre-score plan: committed before any execution, no scores, no post-hoc threshold changes in this file. Per the 2026-11-17 audit (reports/p3_3_experiment_audit.md), the repository cannot independently prove chronology for plans without an earlier committed snapshot; future amendments must be recorded in revision_log.
question: Does a two-parameter-per-modality affine input adapter recover frozen NASA-encoder accuracy lost to the Moonstone-native256 input distribution, beyond what the same head-only probe achieves?
why_this_question: Every P3.3 frozen result feeds the encoder raw Moonstone-native256 elevation/slope under the audited NASA normalization, but the encoder was pretrained under the NASA pre_resize512 pipeline. The adapter is the cheapest way to ask whether input-domain shift, rather than the representation itself, is the binding constraint. It does not train the encoder: only 2 scalars per modality (4 total) plus the ordinary 49-way head receive gradients; the encoder weights and buffers stay frozen.

design.architecture: TerrainTransfer: official pinned NASA base encoder + Conv2d(1,1,1) identity-initialized adapter per modality (weight=1, bias=0) + mean-pooled 768-d tokens + Linear(768,49)

adaptation_arms.frozen: adapters are fixed at identity and receive no gradients; head only (37,681 trainable parameters)
adaptation_arms.input_affine: adapters trainable (2 parameters per modality, 4 total) and gradients pass THROUGH the frozen encoder; encoder parameters/buffers receive no gradients and are never updated (37,685 trainable parameters)

initialization_arms.random: identical architecture, same seed, no pretrained weights

design.input_pipeline: authenticated prefix -> prepare_terrain with the unchanged audited NASA YAML normalization

cohort.test: HOLD; never constructed, read or scored

design.task: 49-class Geology macro-F1 over all 49 classes including absent ones
design.selection: val macro-F1 full, strictly greater, earliest epoch wins ties
design.loss: plain cross-entropy only; the class-balanced-CE variant is out of scope for this plan and would require a separate code + protocol change
design.code_path: scripts/p33_train_pair.py lock/run/replay with src/lunarrisk/nasa_transfer/{torch_adapter,training,experiment}.py; no new model code is introduced by this plan

budget.runs: 2 adaptations x 2 initialization arms x 3 seeds = 12 training runs, each followed by a fresh-process replay
budget.no_post_hoc_tuning: No learning-rate groups, no adapter-specific learning rate, no class weights, no architecture or budget change after any score is observed
budget.batch_size_resolution: Batch 8 is the pre-registered preferred value for comparability with the frozen probe. Before lock, a no-score pilot measures peak device memory at batch 8 on 8 pre-declared Train samples. If batch 8 is infeasible (OOM or peak > 12 GiB) the pre-registered ladder is 4 then 2; the first feasible value is used for BOTH adaptations and all arms. This decision uses memory only, never scores, and is recorded in the locked manifest.

primary_estimand.name: affine_minus_frozen_pretrained
primary_estimand.definition: For each seed s, delta_s = val_macro_f1_full(input_affine, pretrained, s) - val_macro_f1_full(frozen, pretrained, s). Report mean(delta_s) and sample standard deviation over the three seeds.

decision_rule.SUPPORTED: mean delta >= +0.010 AND all three per-seed deltas > 0
decision_rule.WEAK_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: either +0.005 <= mean delta < +0.010, or mean delta >= +0.010 with any seed delta <= 0
decision_rule.HARM: mean delta <= -0.010 AND all three per-seed deltas < 0

primary_estimand.threshold_rationale: +0.010 is roughly 1.2x the frozen-probe seed sample standard deviation (0.0083) and is comparable to the smaller descriptive fusion macro-F1 deltas (+0.022 to +0.038, reused-Val; see reports/p3_3_experiment_audit.md for their boundary). It was fixed before execution as a practical-effect threshold, not a significance test. Three seeds give a sample standard deviation, never a confidence interval.

secondary_estimands.name: affine_minus_frozen_random
secondary_estimands.definition: Same per-seed contrast on the random-init arms
secondary_estimands.role: descriptive; if only the random arm gains, the adapter is compensating initialization/training dynamics rather than the pretrained domain shift

secondary_estimands.name: difference_in_differences
secondary_estimands.definition: (input_affine pretrained - frozen pretrained) - (input_affine random - frozen random), computed per seed
secondary_estimands.role: descriptive mechanism check only; not a success gate and not a significance claim

secondary_estimands.name: learned_adapter_state
secondary_estimands.definition: Final learned weight and bias for dtm and slope per seed, and the distance from identity
secondary_estimands.role: diagnostic; large deviation shows the adapter is doing real rescaling, near-identity shows the optimizer did not move it. Neither direction alone proves a mechanism.

secondary_estimands.name: frozen_control_sanity
secondary_estimands.definition: The newly run frozen pretrained arm must beat the newly run frozen random arm in 3/3 seeds
secondary_estimands.role: engineering sanity gate for the runner path; the historical frozen probe is prior evidence, not an assumed control

reproducibility_and_controls.paired_initialization: Both arms within a seed share the same adapter and head initialization; the runner enforces identity before scoring
reproducibility_and_controls.paired_order: Identical epoch permutations and minibatch orders across arms within a seed; the runner enforces identical training-order hashes
reproducibility_and_controls.encoder_freeze_proof: Backbone state digest must be unchanged after training; any encoder gradient aborts the run
reproducibility_and_controls.fresh_process_replay: Every one of the 12 runs is replayed in a new process; prediction CSV and metric equality are required
reproducibility_and_controls.historical_frozen_probe: 0.188510 +/- 0.008293 (pretrained) and 0.072138 +/- 0.001763 (random) are cited as prior evidence only. The runner constructs the head through TerrainTransfer rather than a standalone Linear, so the head RNG stream differs and exact numerical reproduction is not expected or required
reproducibility_and_controls.no_repeat_of_completed_work: No terrain scan, product-identity check, preflight from 2026-11-06, P3.2 18-run matrix or frozen-feature matrix is repeated

acceptance_gates: M0 offline: both budget files pass validate_budget; protocol IDs and file paths resolve; compileall passes; no GPU touched

M1a real preflight: new paired input_affine forward/backward on authenticated Train2705 under moonstone_native256_v1, same config SHA256, device cuda and torch version; adapter gradients finite and nonzero; encoder gradients absent; receipt records adaptation=input_affine
M1b memory/time pilot: 8 pre-declared Train samples, forward/backward, no optimizer step; record peak device bytes and seconds; resolve batch size via the pre-registered ladder before any lock
M2 lock: two immutable manifests (frozen, input_affine) over identical assets/cohort/runtime with only adaptation differing; lock both before any task score; record both SHA256 digests

M3 frozen matrix: 6 runs + 6 fresh-process replays; paired initialization/order PASS; backbone digest unchanged; frozen pretrained > frozen random in 3/3 seeds; otherwise BLOCKED, do not start the adapter matrix
M4 adapter matrix: 6 runs + 6 fresh-process replays under the same gates
M5 analysis: per-seed deltas, decision rule applied as written, realized epochs/visits, timings, memory, adapter state and hashes reported

No Test tile is selected, compared, scored or fed to the model; metadata ID tables may be read in full by existing loaders, which is not Test scoring; no cloud compute; no encoder retraining or unfreezing

run_order.actions: python3 -c validate_budget on both budget files; compileall; confirm pinned asset hashes and plan paths
reuse the authenticated Train2705 batch and existing runner recipe with --adapt-inputs --forward-backward; write a new receipt, never overwrite the 2026-11-06 frozen receipt
run_order.approval: requires explicit user authorization for model execution and gradient through the frozen encoder

run_order.actions: forward/backward on 8 pre-declared ordered Train samples at batch 8, no optimizer step; resolve 8 -> 4 -> 2 by peak memory only
run p33_train_pair.py --mode lock twice (frozen control, input_affine) with the matching preflight receipts; record manifest SHA256 values
run_order.approval: user confirms the two manifests are the intended spend

run_order.actions: run 6 frozen runs + replays; apply the frozen-control sanity gate
run 6 input_affine runs + replays under the unchanged lock
run_order.approval: conditional go after M3 passes; no budget edits

run_order.actions: apply the pre-registered decision rule; write reports/evidence with every per-seed number, hash and timing

cost_estimate.measured_component: 43.8 encoder forwards/s including HDF5 decode (287.07 s for 12,580 forwards) under the frozen-feature phase
cost_estimate.unmeasured_component: forward+backward-through-encoder multiplier on this ROCm stack; not measured before this plan
cost_estimate.planning_multiplier: 2.5x to 4x for train steps; validation steps have no backward pass
cost_estimate.frozen_control: up to 616,200 train sample-visits at 20 epochs plus ~138,600 validation forwards = about 4.8 h at the measured forward rate
cost_estimate.input_affine: up to 616,200 train sample-visits x 2.5-4x = about 9.8-15.7 h plus ~0.9 h validation
cost_estimate.replays: 12 fresh-process final evaluations over Train+Val = 75,480 forwards = about 0.5 h
cost_estimate.total_upper_bound: about 15-22 GPU-hours on the single local RX 7900 XT; hard stop and re-scope if the pilot implies more than 30 h
cost_estimate.disk: negligible: per-epoch task-state checkpoints hold 37,681-37,685 parameters; prediction CSVs are tens of MB
cost_estimate.cloud: NONE; no paid compute, no additional GPU

leakage_boundaries: The NASA encoder's pretraining data may geographically overlap the fixed Train/Val cohort; overlap cannot be excluded. This plan measures frozen-transfer under permitted overlap, not generalization.

The P3.2 Moonstone encoder was Geology-supervised on the same Train split and consumes LPGRS FeO/TiO2 channels; it is never used as a leakage-free comparator in this plan and no Moonstone claim is attached.
Val has already been reused for early stopping and selection across P3.3 and other phases; all numbers are exploratory and mildly optimistic. Test remains HOLD.
Only the 4 adapter scalars and the 49-way head are trainable. This is not fine-tuning, LoRA, partial unfreezing, representation adaptation or a new encoder.
No new labels, no composition targets, no external data and no new channels enter this experiment; inputs remain exactly elevation and slope.
Adapter weights are learned on Train only. Val is used only for early stopping/selection under the published rule.
A positive result says input rescaling helps this frozen probe; it does not show that NASA pretraining dominates in-domain supervision, and it does not revise the fusion or Moonstone conclusions.
If adapter parameters move far from identity, report the magnitude but do not claim a physical meaning for the learned scale/shift.
claims_permitted: A paired Val result for the input_affine adapter versus the frozen probe on the fixed cohort, with per-seed deltas and sample standard deviation
A statement that the input-domain shift does or does not cost measurable frozen-transfer accuracy within this probe
A statement that the adapter leaves encoder weights unchanged and adds only 4 trainable scalars beyond the head
claims_not_permitted: Fine-tuning, full-backbone adaptation or LoRA conclusions
Test performance, new-class capability, landing safety, global lunar or generalization claims
Statistical significance from three seeds or a confidence interval
Any claim that input_affine resolves the in-domain leakage problem or proves NASA features superior to Moonstone
Any revision of the fusion, composition, latitude-stratified or learned-gate results
Any claim of NASA preprocessing or physical-scale equivalence (the native256 policy is deliberately not the NASA pipeline)
preconditions_not_yet_met: No real input_affine preflight receipt exists; the 2026-11-06 receipt is frozen_probe adaptation
Neither actual budget is locked; both budget files are proposals until M2
No training for this plan has run; no scores exist
Model execution and gradient through the frozen encoder require explicit user authorization

inputs.runtime: private Python3.12.9, torch2.12.1+rocm7.2, RX7900XT gfx1100, deterministic algorithms, no network
